title: Image
queued: Scan queued. It starts within a minute.
notRunningHint: Nothing is running yet. A scan reads the image of the live release.
scanning: Scanning the image. This takes a few minutes.
noScanRight: Only people who can deploy this service can scan it.
failed: Could not load the findings. Try again.
none: No known vulnerabilities in this image.

errors.notFound: That image is no longer here.
errors.notRunning: This service has no running release to scan.
errors.noApp: That service is no longer on this server.
errors.scanError: The scan stopped with an error. Try again.
errors.lost: The scan stopped before it finished. Try again.
errors.timeout: The scan took too long and was stopped.
errors.imageMissing: The image is no longer on the server. Redeploy, then scan again.
errors.noRoom: Not enough free disk on the server to check this image. Free some space, then try again.
errors.scannerFailed: The vulnerability scanner stopped with an error. Try again.
errors.reportUnreadable: The scanner's report could not be read. Update Polaris from Settings, then scan again.
errors.daemonOutdated: This needs a newer Polaris. Update from Settings, then try again.
errors.noDaemon: This Polaris runs without its host service, so it cannot scan images here.
